answer_upgrades.question: Describe a time when you worked in a group.
answer_upgrades.original_answer: I worked with four classmates on a software project and we divided the problems.
answer_upgrades.revised_answer: I worked with four classmates on a software engineering project. We divided the tasks, set weekly deadlines and reviewed each other's work. At first, communication was difficult, but the project became much smoother once we used a shared checklist. The experience taught me that teamwork is not just about sharing work; it is also about keeping everyone informed.

answer_upgrades.question: Should students learn to do group work?
answer_upgrades.original_answer: Yes, because group work is group work for students and it is useful.
answer_upgrades.revised_answer: Yes, because group work helps students practise communication and problem-solving. For example, a team project requires them to divide tasks, negotiate different ideas and take responsibility for a shared result.
changes: Support the opinion with an example
